slope_noise.definition: per episode: OLS line (centre vs frame) over the last min(40, n) detection frames of the PEG+ track before the anchor; sigma_ax = sqrt(RSS/(n-2)) per axis; sigma_ep = sqrt(sigma_x^2 + sigma_y^2) (= sqrt(2) sigma_axis when equal); sigma = median over the 43 tracked episodes.
slope_noise.curve: rms_err(K) = sigma * sqrt(12 / K^3)  (RMS length of the 2-D slope error of an OLS fit on K equally spaced points with white noise sigma_ep; median length of the 2-D error would be x sqrt(ln 4 / 2) = x 0.83 of this)
